info.title: API.SH: Centauro
info.description: The Centauro API from API.SH: public Centauro data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

parameters.name: route

parameters.name: key

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Search suggestions Centauro shows while typing (terms and links) plus up to six suggested products with prices. Without `q`: the shop's current top searches, ranked.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/centauro-autocomplete

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: What the shopper typed, e.g. `tenis`. Leave out for the top searches.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Centauro's category menu as a tree (sports, footwear, clothing, brands, teams and more): name, link and `category` path for `/centauro/v1/search`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/centauro-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Centauro product in one color: name, model, brand, description, availability, price, list price, Pix price and discount, installment plans, seller, every color (code, name, link, image), every size with its SKU, EAN, stock flag, price, Pix price, installments and seller (marketplace sizes can have their own seller), category, group, gender, age group, collection, breadcrumb, rating and review count, images and videos, the product information tabs as text (characteristics, dimensions and weight), a low-stock flag and the link to similar products.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/centauro-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A Centauro product link (e.g. `https://www.centauro.com.br/tenis-masculino-nike-revolution-8-995996.html?cor=31`), a model code (`995996`) or a model plus color code (`99599631`).

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color code from `colors` (e.g. `31`). Default: the color in the link, else the shop's default color.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Tênis Masculino Nike Revolution 8
example.category_path: Calçados > Tênis > Corrida / Caminhada > Corrida > Masculino > Nike > Adulto > Running

get.description:
Customer reviews of a Centauro product: rating, text, date, reviewer display name, city, verified and recommend flags, helpful votes, what they liked, and replies; plus the total, average rating, rating breakdown (1-5), the review tags with counts, top tags and use cases. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/centauro-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A Centauro product link or model code, e.g. `995996`.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color code, to read the reviews the shop shows for that color first.

parameters.name: sentiment
parameters.description: Only reviews with this sentiment.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only reviews with this tag (a `tag` from `tags`, e.g. `beautiful`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page, 1-30 (default 10).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Centauro (centauro.com.br, Brazil's largest sporting-goods store) product search and category browse: product id, model, color, name, link, brand, seller, price, list price, Pix price, discount, installments, availability, rating and review count, categories, tags, color and size counts, SKUs, images, the physical stores that stock it, color variants with their prices, and a short description. Also returns every facet the shop shows (brand, size, gender, product type, price band, sport, modality, category, color, discount, age, line, promotion, store, seller) with counts; pass a value's `filter` back in `filters`. Totals above 10,000 are reported as 10,000 (`total_capped`). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/centauro-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: What to search, e.g. `tenis`, `bola`, `chuteira society`. Optional when `category` or `filters` is given.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category path from `/centauro/v1/categories` (`category`) or a centauro.com.br/nav link, e.g. `categorias/calcados/produto/tenis`.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Facet filters from the response's `facets` (each value's `filter`), separated by `;`, e.g. `marca:nike;genero:feminino`. Filters on the same facet are combined with OR, different facets with AND.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default `relevance`).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1-500 (default 1).

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Products per page, 1-100 (default 36).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
